title: Zero-Shot Quantization via Weight-Space Arithmetic
abstract: arXiv:2604.03420v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We show that robustness to post-training quantization (PTQ) is a transferable direction in weight space. We call this direction the quantization vector: extracted from a donor task by simple weight-space arithmetic, it can be used to patch a receiver model and improve PTQ Top-1 accuracy by up to 60% in a 3-bit setting, without receiver-side quantization-aware training (QAT). When using no receiver validation data, the method provides a zero-shot, low-cost alternative to QAT for extremely low-bit deployment. Across multiple vision and language models and more than 30 tasks, donor quantization vectors often yield substantial gains even when donor and receiver tasks differ markedly. We further prove rigorously that quantization vectors are well-defined and do not suffer from reparameterization symmetries, and provide a local geometric account of their effect. translated_title: 基于权重空间算术的零样本量化
translated_abstract: 我们证明了训练后量化（PTQ）的鲁棒性是权重空间中一个可迁移的方向。我们将这一方向称为量化向量：通过简单的权重空间算术从供体任务中提取，可用于修补接收模型，在3比特设置下将PTQ Top-1准确率提升最多60%，且无需在接收端进行量化感知训练（QAT）。在不使用任何接收端验证数据的情况下，该方法为极低比特部署提供了一种零样本、低成本的QAT替代方案。在多个视觉与语言模型以及30多个任务上的实验表明，即使供体任务与接收任务差异显著，供体量化向量通常仍能带来可观的收益。我们进一步严格证明了量化向量是良定义的，且不受重参数化对称性的影响，并对其效果给出了局部几何层面的解释。这些结果共同表明，量化鲁棒性可以成为……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出通过简单的权重空间算术从供体任务中提取“量化向量”来修补接收模型，从而在不进行量化感知训练、不使用接收端验证数据的零样本场景下，将3比特量化的Top-1准确率提升最多60%。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that a "quantization vector" extracted from a donor task via simple weight-space arithmetic can patch a receiver model, boosting 3-bit post-training quantization Top-1 accuracy by up to 60% in a zero-shot setting without quantization-aware training or receiver-side validation data.
